sections.label: Concept
sections.content: Variables Python mein boxes jaa khaan jaa andar hum data store karin. Har variable ka ek data type houn (jaise number, text, ya boolean). Input/output ka matlab program aur user beech communication—user to data lena (input) aur results show karna (output).

sections.label: Example
sections.content:
# Variable declare karna
naam = "علی"  # String (text)
age = 25      # Integer (number)
height = 5.9  # Float (decimal number)
is_student = True  # Boolean (True/False)

# Input lena
user_name = input("اپنا نام تحریر کریو: ")
print("Hello, ", user_name)

# Data type check karna
print(type(age))  # Output: <class 'int'>

sections.label: Practice
sections.content: ایک پروگرام تحریر کریو جو user to 2 numbers input لیو، انھن کي جمع کريو، پوء result print کريو.
